text: I've been going back and forth about whether to take the Series A. The terms look okay but I'm worried about giving up too much control. The lead investor is pushing for a board seat and I'm not sure that's right for us at this stage.

text: We had a good call with the two finalists today. Sarah's experience is stronger but James has more energy and is cheaper. I keep going back and forth. I need to decide this week but I genuinely don't know.

decisions: which candidate to hire — Sarah vs James

text: The app is working but it's slow. I could rewrite the backend in Go which would fix the performance issues, but it's a big undertaking and I'm not sure if now is the right time. Or I could just optimize the current Python code.

decisions: whether to rewrite the backend in Go or optimize current Python code

text: I already signed the lease last week. The new office is great. We moved in yesterday and everyone loves it.

I'm thinking about the pricing. We could go freemium or straight paid. Freemium means more users but lower revenue per user. Paid means fewer users but we can be more selective. I haven't decided yet.

decisions: whether to use freemium or paid pricing model

text: I want to build more features eventually but right now I'm focused on the launch. Maybe someday I'll add the analytics dashboard. Not something I'm actively deciding on.

There are two paths here. I can double down on the enterprise channel which is slower but higher value, or push into SMB which is faster to close but churns more. The board wants me to pick one by next quarter.

decisions: whether to focus on enterprise or SMB channel

text: I've decided. We're going with the enterprise path. The SMB market is too competitive right now and our product is better suited for complex use cases anyway.
The co-founder situation is uncomfortable. We haven't really talked about equity splits or roles. It's just been assumed. I know we need to have that conversation but neither of us has brought it up.

decisions: how to handle the co-founder equity and roles conversation

text: I spoke to three advisors today. All of them said the same thing — raise now before the market gets worse. I think they're right. I'm going to start the process next week.
